package.name: demo_camera_track
package.description:
Flies the simulated m4e from what its camera sees: reads frames off the wrapper's main_camera_stream, finds a target by colour, and turns the target's position in the IMAGE into a body-frame velocity command -- yaw to centre it, climb or descend to centre it, close or open the range to hold its apparent size. Publishes an annotated frame on ~/image for RViz.
Restricted to the /wrapper/psdk_ros2 surface, like the other demos, and deliberately free of OpenCV: the detector walks the sensor_msgs/Image buffer directly.
